game.title: NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139...
game.blurb: Updated version of the action RPG NieR Replicant, about a young man who sets out with Grimoire Weiss to save his sister, from Toylogic, released 2021-04-23. RAWG average playtime: 16 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The journey with Grimoire Weiss and companions, and the endings. Spoiler-guarded; most achievements here are hidden.

chapters.title: Combat, Magic and Words
chapters.summary: Long combos, learning every type of magic and collecting words.

chapters.title: Quests, Weapons and Wealth
chapters.summary: Village quests, every weapon, weapon upgrades and materials, gold, and the novel segments about your friends.

chapters.title: Boss Time Trials
chapters.summary: Beating named bosses within a time limit.

chapters.title: Gardening, Fishing and Pastimes
chapters.summary: Hidden achievements whose names point to gardening, fishing and other pastimes.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page under "NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139..."; "NieR Replicant" redirects to "NieR Gestalt", the 2010 original (completion stage 0, Walkthrough and other subpages linked but not written), which was not used. nier.fandom.com answers the API under the full title, with about 112 linked pages, including "NieR/Endings", "Key Fragments", "Fishing (NieR)" and "Forging Master"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema has no app name. 25 of 47 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions. Eight hidden ones were placed by name alone: "Legendary Gardener", "Fish of Legend", "A Round by the Pond" and "The Sheep Whisperer" in the pastimes chapter, and "Material Hunter", "Upgrade Apprentice", "Reform Specialist" and "Forging Master" with weapons; this is a judgement call. The rest, including "All Aboared!", "Lightspeed Fighter", "Dear Diary", "The Little Mermaid" and "Daredevil", sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder, though some may be side goals. One hidden name is a hex byte string ("e8 a8 98 ..."). The visible "The Final Verse" ("Thank you for playing!") is also in the main story.
